sections.title: Compiling
sections.description: Compile, link, and inspect C programs from the command line.

snippets.code:
# Compile and link in one step
gcc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -O2 main.c util.c -o app

# Compile separately, then link the object files
gcc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -c main.c
gcc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -c util.c
gcc main.o util.o -o app

# Build a static library from util.o
ar rcs libutil.a util.o
gcc main.o -L. -lutil -o app

# Keep debug symbols
gcc -std=c17 -g -O0 main.c -o app

# Turn on runtime checks for memory and undefined behavior
gcc -std=c17 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined main.c -o app

# Inspect macros and includes after preprocessing
gcc -E main.c | less

# Ask pkg-config for the flags of an installed library
gcc -std=c17 main.c $(pkg-config --cflags --libs libcurl) -o fetch
